meta.title: Submit a bid on an eRFX RFQ project
warnings: moved open_event to the front — the steps after it act on that event's page
moved open_event to the front — the steps after it act on that event's page

steps.note: Open an existing suitable RFQ event because no event title or ID is supplied.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Accept the required terms before submitting the quote.
Enter a quote of 100 and submit it from the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the bid and shows the RFQ as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page to verify the submitted response.
Confirm the buyer sees Vendor A's direct RFQ response and participation count.
Open Master QCS and verify the submitted vendor is present in the comparison grid.
Confirm Master QCS contains one real vendor column for Vendor A.
